all_found.desc: [BUG] UninstallHookInstall and DisableStopGate use `git config --unset metareview.stopGate`; when the key has multiple local values git exits 5 and changes nothing, and the code treats exit 5 as 'already absent', then removes core.hooksPath and reports success. Raised by CodeRabbit on PR #195. With duplicate stopGate lines (hand-edited config, repeated manual adds), uninstall reports success while the Stop hook still reads true and keeps gating.
